eyebrow.en: one command · vertical motion · editable & reusable

headline.zh:
把文案变成竖屏知识动效卡片
一条命令，改一行即时重渲
headline.en:
Turn text into vertical knowledge motion cards
one command, edit a line and re-render instantly

sub.zh: 产物是能 diff、能单卡重渲的模板项目——不是剪映那种黑盒草稿。离线、无真人、无配音。
sub.en: The output is an editable, diff-able template project you can re-render card-by-card — not a black-box draft. Offline, faceless, no voiceover.

hero.command: npx kinecard render examples/card.yaml -t minimal -o out.mp4

title.en: One command to a finished clip

body.zh: 把一段结构化文案渲染成 9:16 竖屏动效卡片视频——标题淡入、正文逐行 kinetic 上浮、卡片间转场，全程离线。
body.en: Render structured text into a 9:16 vertical motion-card video — title fades in, body lines animate in line-by-line, cards transition, all offline.

title.en: Edit a line, re-render one card

body.zh: --project 写出一个可编辑的模板项目；改 card.yaml 的一行文字或 accent 色，单卡重渲，画面即时更新。
body.en: --project writes an editable template project; tweak one line or accent colour in card.yaml and re-render just that card — the picture updates instantly.

body.zh: 抖音 / 视频号 / B站 预设自带画布、帧率与时长上限；字幕安全区超限或时长超标会主动告警，免得你被平台裁切。
body.en: Douyin / Shipinhao / Bilibili presets carry the canvas, frame rate and duration cap; it warns you when a line spills past the subtitle safe zone or the clip runs over — so the platform never crops you.

chips: › 抖音 / 视频号 / B站

body.zh: minimal 居中淡入、spotlight 聚光高亮、mono 等宽打字机——kinecard init 一键起手，kinecard list 看模板画廊。
body.en: minimal centered fade-up, spotlight dark highlight, mono monospace typewriter — `kinecard init` scaffolds a starter, `kinecard list` browses the gallery.
